rationale.A: ~4.9 km in mixed traffic on 40-50 km/h Tuomarilantie/Friisinmäentie/Nuijalantie, many unsignalled crossings
rationale.B: As A plus Siltakatu in traffic at the start; most mixed traffic
rationale.C: Tuomarilantie 1.6 km in traffic, then quieter Kilo streets and park paths
rationale.D: Same corridor as A but entirely on side paths beside the 50 km/h roads; no mixed traffic
rationale.E: Same as D with a park-path start
rationale.F: Kirkkojärvi and Kauniainen/Kilo park paths about half the way, side paths the rest, no mixed traffic, 2 lights for +3 min
rationale.G: All separated but mostly beside Turuntie (60 km/h); +7 min
rationale.H: All separated, mostly side paths beside collectors; +7 min

notes: A/B ride in the carriageway of the same streets that D/E follow on side paths. The geometry is nearly the same, but they are very different for calm, so I did not group them. F has both the fewest lights (2 vs 8) and the calmest route for +3 min.
